chunks: And from a sermon of his (peace be upon him) that follows this pattern
and in it is mention of the Day of Resurrection and the conditions of the people approaching [it]
ai.seo_question: What is the main theme of this sermon from Nahj al-Balagha regarding the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: This introductory note by Sharif al-Radi frames the sermon as a profound eschatological discourse, highlighting the transformative reality of the Day of Resurrection and the varying spiritual states of humanity. It underscores the Shia emphasis on *ma'ad* (return) as a central tenet of faith, inviting the reader to reflect on the moral accountability that defines the human journey toward the Divine. The context suggests a rhetorical style typical of Nahj al-Balagha, designed to awaken the soul from worldly heedlessness.
